per_wiki.sql: SELECT wiki,count(*) FROM revisions GROUP BY wiki

welcome_on_peak.sql: SELECT substr(time,1,10),count(*) FROM revisions WHERE page_key='dse~WillkommenImWiki' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3

welcome_last.sql: SELECT id,time,label FROM revisions WHERE page_key='dse~WillkommenImWiki' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 3

no_prior.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM pages WHERE n_revs_before=0

peak_week.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM revisions WHERE time>='2026-06-16' AND time<'2026-06-23'
